options.content:
### Grafana Explore → Loki forensic proof

Use these only when explaining log evidence. Metrics show counts; Loki shows the searchable event trail.

**Start broad first**
```logql
{job=~".+"}
{job=~".+"} |= "TAMPER"
{job=~".+"} |= "MV-001"
```

**If job labels are configured**
```logql
{job="mec-edge"} |= "TAMPER" |= "MV-001"
{job="mqtt-bridge"} |= "telemetry_tamper"
{job="mqtt-bridge"} |= "400"
{job="docker-containers"} |= "TAMPER"
```

Use Loki as forensic evidence only after the dashboard counters show MQTT/MEC rejection.

### Final Demo Commands — run only what you need

#### 0) Health checks
```bash
docker compose ps
curl -s http://localhost:5001/health
curl -s http://localhost:8010/health
curl -s http://localhost:3100/ready
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=up" | python3 -m json.tool
```

#### 1) Prometheus target checks
```bash
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=up%7Bjob%3D%22open5gs-amf%22%7D" | python3 -m json.tool
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=up%7Bjob%3D%22open5gs-upf%22%7D" | python3 -m json.tool
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=up%7Bjob%3D~%22mqtt-bridge%7Cmqtt-to-mec-bridge%22%7D" | python3 -m json.tool
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=up%7Bjob%3D%22scenario-simulator%22%7D" | python3 -m json.tool
```

#### 2) MQTT pipeline proof
```bash
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=mqtt_messages_received_total" | python3 -m json.tool
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=mqtt_messages_forwarded_total" | python3 -m json.tool
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=mqtt_messages_rejected_total" | python3 -m json.tool
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=mqtt_bridge_errors_total" | python3 -m json.tool
docker logs mqtt-bridge --tail 80
```

#### 3) Scenario changes
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8010/scenario/normal
curl -X POST http://localhost:8010/scenario/tcp_syn_like
curl -X POST http://localhost:8010/scenario/udp_like
curl -X POST http://localhost:8010/scenario/icmp_like
curl -X POST http://localhost:8010/scenario/network_congestion
curl -X POST http://localhost:8010/scenario/signal_degradation
curl -X POST http://localhost:8010/scenario/tamper
curl -X POST http://localhost:8010/scenario/replay
```

#### 4) MEC security proof after tamper
```bash
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=mec_tamper_detected_total" | python3 -m json.tool
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=mec_telemetry_rejected_total" | python3 -m json.tool
curl -s "http://localhost:9190/api/v1/query?query=mec_validation_failures_total" | python3 -m json.tool
docker logs mec-edge --tail 120 | grep -i "TAMPER\|WARNING\|MV-001\|400"
```

#### 5) Kali network tests
```bash
docker exec kali-attacker nmap -sT -Pn 10.0.0.45
timeout 10s docker exec kali-attacker hping3 -S --flood -p 5000 10.0.0.45
timeout 10s docker exec kali-attacker hping3 --udp --flood -p 2152 10.0.0.22
timeout 10s docker exec kali-attacker hping3 --icmp --flood 10.0.0.45
timeout 20s docker exec kali-attacker slowhttptest -c 80 -H -i 10 -r 20 -t GET -u http://10.0.0.45:5000/health -x 24 -p 3
```

#### 6) Loki forensic proof
```bash
curl -G -s "http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/label/job/values" | python3 -m json.tool
curl -G -s "http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/query" --data-urlencode 'query={job=~".+"} |= "TAMPER"' | python3 -m json.tool
curl -G -s "http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/query" --data-urlencode 'query={job=~".+"} |= "MV-001"' | python3 -m json.tool
```

#### 7) Recovery
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8010/scenario/normal
docker compose ps
curl -s http://localhost:5001/health
```
